notes.title: Mass Exodus Redux v2.0.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Another round of bug fixes, let us know if we missed any!

[b][h2]Visuals[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Added a sphere to improve the accuracy of grabbing androids
[*]Adjusted idle, walking and running animations, and made them consistent with AI
[/list]

[b][h2]Gameplay and Bug Fixes[/h2][/b][list]
[*]Added "invert Y-axis" options for each player
[*]Grabbing androids is now only possible inside the accuracy sphere
[*]PC Players will no longer spawn directly in front of a control panel in certain areas
[*]It's now easier to turn off control panels
[*]Reduced the default AI count in Assembly Line to 100 (from 150)
[*]Improved AI
[/list]

notes.title: Mass Exodus Redux v2.0.1 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Visuals[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Added Index controller support (and textures)
[*]Added extra padding to certain display panels.
[*]Powerups now display their duration on the UI correctly.
[*]Added a prompt of when the furnace door needs closing.
[/list]

[b][h1]Gameplay and Bug Fixes[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could walk over certain barriers
[*]Fixed an issue where hovering over the player was still showing the highlighted material whilst the player was invisible.
[*]Fixed an issue with the seeker head death sequence
[*]Fixed an issue where the PC player would store reset points whilst still being held by the seeker
[*]Increased player walk speed by 10% and decreased the AI Speed by 25% (The player now walks at the same speed as the AI)
[/list]

notes.title: Mass Exodus v1.2 Patch Notes - The Rework
notes.notes:
The overhaul of the game is finally done, and should fix almost every issue people have had with the game
 
We’re sorry it took so long but it’s worth it! 
 
Here’s a quick summary of some of the bigger things that have changed, amongst others that didn't make the list!
 
[b][h1]New![/h1][/b][list]
[*]New VR area for Main menu and lobby
[*]Post processing effects for the Seeker to make the game much prettier!
[*]Blind has been changed to distort, it no longer removes vision from the Seeker but makes it much harder to see
[*]Pickup sphere for the right hand to make picking up androids much more accurate
[*]Win / Lose screen unique for both players, as well as options to retry or quit the game
[*]Ready up screen for the PC player has an extra step to show what inputs everyone is using and to confirm they’re working
[*]More options for level customisation
[*]Sensitivity for Mouse and Controllers can now be adjusted in game
[*]A brightness slider has been added to the options menu
[*]New loading screen
[*]Teleporters now have icons on the mini-map
[/list]
 
[b][h1]Reworked![/h1][/b][list]
[*]Completely new AI system which is smarter, quicker and better on performance
[*]Mini-map has received a beautiful new look - which shows less of the map to stop players from just watching the seekers head
[*]All animations have been updated for the rogue and androids
[*]Seeker’s handheld remote (left hand) has new UI to show more accurate information
[*]Lighting and effects have all received visual updates
[*]Teleporters on The Core have received a new particle effect and transition animation
[*]UI additions have been made to give the player guidance such as how many panels are left to turn off
[*]Freeze AI has been adjusted so that all robots randomly stop within 0.5 seconds to allow the rogue time to react
[*]Invisibility has received a new visual effect
[/list]

[h1]Please check our other post for information on online changes.[/h1]

Thankyou! 
The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Bug Fixes, purchase problems and performance.
notes.notes:
Hey everyone

Thank you yet again for your continued support with Mass Exodus, today there's a couple of things that we want to talk about.

[h1]The Game[/h1]

We understand that there are some glaring issues with the most recent patch, as well as some underlying issues that we want to fix quickly.

Due to the way the game was made (through a game jam), the base code is not in a stable state to keep updating, so we're rebuilding it from the ground up. This will improve performance amongst other things, [b]drastically[/b].

We aim to have this finished within the next week or two, and hopefully this will resolve almost all of the issues people have been having with the game.

[h1]VR client and PC client[/h1]

We've found since launching the PC client of the game, theres some big issues that stop you from upgrading to the VR version, or gifting either versions to a friend. 

Currently the game has 2 app IDs, but your Steam library only checks to see you have one. So it almost merges them if you upgrade, causing big issues.

We're talking to some of the Steam / Valve team at the moment, on making it so the game is easier to purchase and understand, the new system will hopefully be as follows:[list]

[*]VR Client will be removed from the Store

[*]PC Client will remain as it is

[*]DLC to upgrade unlock VR features (This will be given to everyone who originally owned the VR version of the game)[/list]

Hopefully this will resolve all issues people have been having with the game, purchasing, and even playing without issues.

We'll post here once the game updated. 

Thank you
The Polymerse Team

notes.title: Mass Exodus v1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
 
We’ve been hard at work, adding features and fixing Mass Exodus based on the community’s feedback, and are happy to update the game today with lots of neat additions!
 
We would like to thank everyone who informed us about these problems and made suggestions. 
 
We look forward to hearing what you think of the new additions!
 
[b][h1]New![/h1][/b][list]
[*]VR Navigation: You no longer need to use the PC to join or create games, everything can be done in VR through the new hub room
[*]The VR player will now have a guide for the power ups on their left controller in the main menu
[*]You can now save game settings if they’ve been adjusted for custom games, making it quicker to have rematches
[*]Moving robots to another platform now teleports them back to where they were originally, which stops the Seeker from just moving everyone away from a control panel
[*]The Scanner power for the seeker now changes colour depending on distance from the Rogue (Red / Far > Green / Close)
[*]UI prompts have been added to floating blue cogs when you walk through them, to show you if you can collect them or not
[*]New Oculus controller models have been added for Oculus users
[*]Vive controller model has received updates
[*]VR Players can now press the Menu button on the VIVE or the Oculus will bring up the controls for the game
[*]PC players can now press ‘SPACE’ on PC, ‘BACK’ on xbox controllers or ‘SHARE’ on Playstation controllers while in game for a help screen popup
[*]Added a “controls” screen in the ready up area
[*]You can now use the grip buttons as well as the triggers to pick up androids as a Seeker
[*]Added a new way to grab robots as the seeker, using a small sphere as a guide you can pick out the rogue amongst a crowd much easier
[*]Added controls help to the Ready Up screen
[*]Region selection menu to improve online connection
[/list]


[b][h1]Fixes[/h1][/b][list]
[*]Invisibility no longer shows the rogue player as black instead of transparent
[*]Camera / player no longer moves while typing in the chat box or while paused
[*]Adjusted distance required to activate control panels, which should now be easier to activate
[*]Scanner now recharges if the setting is enabled in custom game settings
[*]Screen resolution should now scale correctly
[*]You can no longer move upwards through the ceiling as the Seeker on The Boiler Room map
[*]The mini-map for PC players will now show at the start of the game on The Core level
[*]You no longer have to “ready up” the VR person last to start the game
[*]Fixed an issue on the Boiler Room where the Seeker’s hand would disappear 
[/list]

We’re currently working on an exiting new project which we can reveal soon, but we will keep a keen eye on the Mass Exodus forums to see what needs adding or changing. We are aware of a couple bugs regarding multi-player which we are still working on.
 
If you have time to, leaving a review on our store page helps us massively.
 
Thanks to everyone that has supported us so far.

[b]The Polymerse Team[/b]

notes.title: We're nearly there, Mass Exodus full release.
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27118244/79f20d86ff782e1f8f9eed4691e4b45b6e533506.png[/img]

Mass Exodus is pushing closer and closer to full relase!

Online Multiplayer, no longer do you need VR to play our game, connect with your friends online and play against them in any map with up to 5 players!

Shut the Seeker down once and for all!
Witness The Core, the power that runs the Seeker - The 3rd and final level for Mass Exodus.
The Core has tesla coils to zap androids to dust, teleports to confuse the seeker and frayed whips of power that make the level stunning to look at.


We’ll be pushing this into beta really soon, so keep your eyes peeled!

Thank you for supporting Mass Exodus,
Let us know if you have any feedback!

The Polymerse Team
